name: Pedagogic developmental benchmarks of syntactic complexity
description: Defines developmental benchmarks of syntactic complexity to identify each learner's zone of proximal development and guide individualized syntactic challenge.
reputation: Niche, primarily used in developmental linguistics and educational assessment research with limited adoption in mainstream ML benchmark suites.
notes: Designed for human/child language assessment rather than large-scale LLM evaluation; dataset sizes and language variation can be limited and annotations depend on expert judgement.
